propositions: Hosted OpenAI providers (bare openai:/gpt-*/o1/o3/chatgpt without custom endpoint) must resolve to openai-responses: by default instead of openai-chat:

Custom OpenAI endpoints (top-level base_url, per-slot endpoint, or per-candidate endpoint) must remain on openai-chat: because vendor /v1/responses support is unknown and would silently ignore base_url

An explicit openai-chat: qualifier or provider="openai-chat" fallback must exist as a deprecated compatibility surface with a once-per-run notice and v1.0.0 removal target, but NOT warn when forced by custom endpoint

The openai-responses qualifier must be registered in config resolution (KNOWN_PROVIDER_NAMES), provider inference (_pydantic_ai_known_providers), and capability resolution (_PROFILE_RESOLVERS) so lazy pydantic-ai building preserves structured output parity

All four constraint sites named in the capability matrix (hosted OpenAI, custom base_url builder, per-candidate endpoint override, and custom endpoint in model-class slots) must be threaded with endpoint parameter through resolve_class, resolve_fallback_chain, primary_endpoint_for, fallback_targets_for, and build_fallback_model
